title: The tools the target declares, grouped into the services a simulator would stand in for
description: Its own pass because grouping is a judgment with evidence rather than a string match, and it decides how many simulators exist -- which makes it reviewable at gate 1 rather than derived. `inputs_seen` is the same per-input accounting every other pass that owns a claim kind carries: this pass owns the `tool` kind, so a skimmed read of 01-claims/ shows up as a recomputable number rather than as a well-formed partial nobody can distinguish from a diligent one.
